function.name: write_file
function.description: Create a NEW file with the given content. Refused if the file already exists: use edit_file to change an existing file.

path.description: File name inside the task directory, e.g. solution.py. Use the EXACT name given in the task.

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace exact text in an existing file. The default tool for changing any existing file. Each oldText must match exactly (whitespace and indentation matter) and be unique in the file; edits are matched against the original file and must not overlap.

path.description: File name inside the task directory.

edits.description: One entry per location to change.

oldText.description: Exact text currently in the file; include 2-3 lines of context if needed to make it unique.

newText.description: Replacement text; empty string deletes oldText.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a file's contents with line numbers (format: N<tab>line).

path.description: File name inside the task directory.

function.name: run_python
function.description: Run Python 3 and return the exit code plus stdout+stderr (10 s timeout). Pass `code` to run a snippet (it can `from solution import ...`; put asserts or prints in it to test your function), or `path` to run a .py file from the task directory such as a test file.

code.description: Python source to run. Use this OR path.

path.description: A .py file in the task directory to run. Use this OR code.
